headword: {官房長官|かんぼうちょうかん}

definitions.explanation: A senior Japanese cabinet minister who heads the Cabinet Secretariat, coordinates government policy, and acts as the government's chief spokesperson.

examples.japanese: {官房長官|かんぼうちょうかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}→記者会見：19954_kishakaiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: The Chief Cabinet Secretary held a press conference.

examples.japanese: {官房長官|かんぼうちょうかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{答|こた}える→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧。
examples.english: The Chief Cabinet Secretary answers reporters' questions every day.

examples.japanese: {官房長官|かんぼうちょうかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支|ささ}える→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧⟦{要|かなめ}→要：19357_kaname⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ポスト→ポスト：02965_posuto⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The Chief Cabinet Secretary is regarded as the key post supporting the prime minister.

notes:
Heads the {内閣官房|ないかくかんぼう} (Cabinet Secretariat). The twice-daily press conference makes the holder the most visible voice of the government, and the post is often a stepping stone to prime minister.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内閣官房長官|ないかくかんぼうちょうかん}: the full title, Chief Cabinet Secretary
- {官房長官|かんぼうちょうかん}⟦{会見|かいけん}→会見：11447_kaiken⟧: the Chief Cabinet Secretary's press conference
- {官房長官|かんぼうちょうかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}する→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧: the Chief Cabinet Secretary announces
